angle_convention: surface_deg is rotation about the segment long axis; 0 is exterior-lateral, 90 is anterior. fraction is distance from the proximal anatomical landmark divided by joint-to-joint segment length.

definitions.upper: Hypothetical midpoint between acromion and lateral epicondyle; exterior-lateral surface. PHYTMO confirms the surface only, not this landmark distance.
definitions.forearm: Hypothetical midpoint between lateral epicondyle and ulnar styloid; exterior-lateral surface. PHYTMO confirms the surface only, not this landmark distance.

definitions.upper: 30% from acromion toward lateral epicondyle; exterior-lateral surface.
definitions.forearm: 30% from lateral epicondyle toward ulnar styloid; exterior-lateral surface.

definitions.upper: 72% from acromion toward lateral epicondyle; exterior-lateral surface.
definitions.forearm: 72% from lateral epicondyle toward ulnar styloid; exterior-lateral surface.

definitions.forearm: 30% from lateral epicondyle toward ulnar styloid; anterior surface.
